# kafka_topic (List Resource)

Lists existing Kafka topics, e.g. to generate `import` blocks and configuration with `terraform query`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every non-internal topic in the cluster
list "kafka_topic" "all" {
  provider = kafka
}

# Only the orders domain, with current settings in the output
list "kafka_topic" "orders" {
  provider         = kafka
  include_resource = true

  config {
    name_prefix = "orders."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_internal` (Boolean) Include internal topics whose name starts with `__` (e.g. `__consumer_offsets`). Default `false`.
- `name_prefix` (String) Only topics whose name starts with this prefix.
- `name_regex` (String) Only topics whose name matches this RE2 regular expression.
